text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Flight. It's your birthday, right? 
Happy birthday.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Air Groove-san! You went through the 
trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Huh, it was today!? Tell me sooner~! I 
would've thrown you a big celebration!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you. It felt a little 
embarrassing to bring it up myself.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
How modest. If people knew, I imagine many 
would wish to celebrate, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to your advice, I saw them gain 
confidence in themselves and move forward 
with renewed vigor.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Your passion for clothing is undoubtedly a 
source of strength for everyone. You're 
doing well.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
"...Kinda reminds me of my little sister. 
If you like that sort of thing, I could do 
it for ya too, y'know?"

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, Flight, you're doing an amazing job! 
Seriously impressive! Good girl, good 
girl♪

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"...Ehehe. Now I really want to see my big 
sis."
